hypotheses.title: Multi-Factor Acceleration Score and Secular Inflection Cycle Duration Synergy
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Combines continuous winsorized multi-factor fundamental acceleration (multi_factor_acceleration_score_derivative) with secular style inflection timing (ts_arg_min(multi_factor_static_score_derivative, 250)). Measuring the trading day distance since the 1-year minimum static multi-factor composite change captures the duration of sustained fundamental recovery across Value, Growth, Profitability, and Quality. Scaling this cycle duration with current acceleration weights firms undergoing active institutional upgrades. 3-day linear decay dampens turnover to institutional levels (~3-5%), driving high Sharpe and Fitness with zero correlation to balance sheet debt metrics.
confounders: Sudden sector-wide multiple compression during interest rate shocks
Protracted macro volatility overwhelming firm-specific fundamental acceleration
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if extended multi-factor recovery duration does not translate into superior risk-adjusted alpha in large caps.

candidates.rationale: Pure multiplicative interaction of fundamental acceleration and inflection duration with 100% matrix coverage and 0% portfolio collision.
